# spec/extract

`spec/extract` — `vector spec extract`: an RFC XML v3 spec (xml2rfc's output
for a kramdown-rfc spec) to its canonical contract. The profile
(spec/profile) reads the contract; extract records what the profile cannot
know, the bytes it read, runs the gates `spec check` runs, and writes the
contract in one canonical form, so a committed contract can be checked
against its spec with `--check`. It never touches the network: an RFC found
nowhere is an error that says how to fetch it.

Generated from [src/spec/extract.ts](https://github.com/amritk/vector/blob/main/src/spec/extract.ts).

### extractContract

Extracts the canonical contract for a spec: reads the spec and every RFC
it references, reads the contract under the profile, records the bytes
read, and runs the gates `spec check` runs.

```ts
function extractContract(
  xmlPath: string,
  contractPath: string,
  root: string,
  readers: SourceReaders,
): ExtractOutcome
```

<scalar-field name="xmlPath" type="string" required>

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="contractPath" type="string" required>

where the contract is to be written, which its relative paths are from

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="root" type="string" required>

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="readers" type="SourceReaders" required>

the source readers (extractReaders)

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="returns" type="ExtractOutcome">

</scalar-field>

### extractGateRefusals

The gates' findings as refusals, each at the line of the part it is about.
A gate that places a finding (a note, gateIssue) is placed by the note's
`at` through the locator; a finding no note places is at the spec's root.
Each refusal is given once, since two fields of one part can break one
rule on one line, and they are sorted by line. A finding about
allowSurvivors is the sidecar's, so it names that file, after the rest.

```ts
function extractGateRefusals(
  report: CheckReport,
  notes: CheckNote[],
  locator: ProfileLocator,
  sidecar: string,
  mainRfc: i32,
): ProfileRefusal[]
```

<scalar-field name="report" type="CheckReport" required>

what the gates found

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="notes" type="CheckNote[]" required>

where they placed each finding, and their warnings

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="locator" type="ProfileLocator" required>

where each part of the contract was read

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="sidecar" type="string" required>

the sidecar's path

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="mainRfc" type="i32" required>

the main source's RFC number; 0 when the spec is its own

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="returns" type="ProfileRefusal[]">

the refusals, in order

</scalar-field>

### extractUnifiedDiff

A unified diff of `a` (the file `aName`) against `b` (`bName`), with three
lines of context, or "" when they are equal. Lines are matched by their
longest common subsequence.

```ts
function extractUnifiedDiff(
  a: string,
  b: string,
  aName: string,
  bName: string,
): string
```

<scalar-field name="a" type="string" required>

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="b" type="string" required>

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="aName" type="string" required>

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="bName" type="string" required>

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="returns" type="string">

</scalar-field>
